# Tabs and columns

Install the package:

<Tabs>
<Panel label="pnpm">

```sh
pnpm add yapparatus
```

</Panel>
<Panel label="npm">

```sh
npm install yapparatus
```

</Panel>
</Tabs>

Start it:

<Tabs>
<Panel label="pnpm">

```sh
pnpm dev
```

</Panel>
<Panel label="npm">

```sh
npm run dev
```

</Panel>
</Tabs>

<Ref to="retry" /> compares two versions.

<Listing id="retry" caption="The retry delay, before and after backoff.">

<Columns>
<Panel label="Before">

```ts
await sleep(200);
```

</Panel>
<Panel label="After">

```ts
for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
  await sleep(100 * 2 ** attempt);
}
```

</Panel>
</Columns>

</Listing>
